result.reason: The added provision reaches the preferred insurance position: CGL at USD 1M/2M, E&O at USD 2M, cyber at USD 5M for processing Customer Data, statutory workers’ compensation, and certificates on request. It preserves the existing risk-of-loss allocation. However, requiring all coverages for one year after termination exceeds the playbook and is not necessary, particularly for CGL and workers’ compensation. “Customer data” should also be capitalized if “Customer Data” is the defined term.
